none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Constrained, possibly nonsmooth, ρ-weakly convex minimization on a nonempty closed convex domain D. A selected vector v(x) satisfies f(y) ≥ f(x) + ⟨v(x),y−x⟩ − (ρ/2)‖y−x‖² for all x,y∈D. Convexity of f is not required.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WeaklyConvexHeavyTailed.lean: spec.admissible, weak-convexity inequality and domain conditions.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Stochastic subgradient queries return g(x,ω), with E[g(x,ω)]=v(x). Oracle seeds are independent and identically distributed. Only subgradient and projection queries are available.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WeaklyConvexHeavyTailed.lean: Query; spec.admissible, oracle.answer, IID and unbiasedness conditions. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: StochasticGeneralized.IID.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact Euclidean projection onto D is available as an oracle query. Projection and stochastic subgradient queries each count as one call in the fixed total oracle budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WeaklyConvexHeavyTailed.lean: Query.projection and spec.admissible projection conditions. LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform central-moment bound E‖g(x,ω)−v(x)‖^α ≤ σ^α, where 1<α≤2 and σ≥0. For α<2, finite variance is not required. The underlying oracle is unbiased.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WeaklyConvexHeavyTailed.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible, integrability, unbiasedness and α-moment conditions.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; no dimension factor appears in the supplied budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The selected mean subgradient satisfies ‖v(x)‖≤G. A finite lower bound lower satisfies f(x0)−lower≤Δ. All parameters, including ρ>0, G>0, σ≥0, 1<α≤2, Δ≥0, ε>0 and x0∈D, are public. The objective, domain, oracle maps and sampling laws are hidden. No bounded-domain assumption is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/WeaklyConvexHeavyTailed.lean: Params, Instance, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid and spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm_squared
accuracy.details: For the constrained proximal minimizer prox(x)∈argmin_{y∈D}{f(y)+ρ‖y−x‖²}, require E[(2ρ)²‖X−prox(X)‖²]≤ε², with integrability. This is squared Moreau-envelope gradient accuracy at smoothing parameter 1/(2ρ). Proximal minimizers must exist, and the criterion applies to every map satisfying IsProx.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The output X must be measurable and belong to D for every realization.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The accuracy bound holds in expectation over algorithm randomness and oracle seeds under their product probability law, using a fixed oracle budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines constrained weakly convex Moreau-envelope stationarity with an unbiased subgradient oracle whose central moment may have order below two, permitting infinite variance.
